newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Bunds to trade sideways, eye 101.14.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Bunds to trade sideways, eye 101.14.

text.p: June Bund futures traded on LIFFE will move sideways on Thursday and seek a test of a recent high at 101.14 later in the session, technical analysts said.

"Near term we'll probably see a bit of sidesways lower action. I'm looking for a test of 101.14, the high on April 17," said Robin Wilkin, senior technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London. "If it can break 101.14, although today it won't necessarily fly away, that would suggest we may try and push up towards a 62 percent retracement level at 101.58."
At 0711 GMT, June Bund futures were at 100.89, up eight basis points from Wednesday's close.
To the downside, Wilkin said Bunds were finding support at Wednesday's low at 100.74 for now but the choppy sideways action could push them lower.

"I'm looking for it to hold over 100.58 if we do see some selling and the market comes under a bit of pressure," he said. "If we started getting through 100.58 with good volume then we could probably push back down to re-test the April 22 low at 100.35."
On a short-term bearish view, Wilkin said the contract would need to head down through 100.35 and 100.25, to start signaling a top at 101.14.
A 62 percent Fibonacci retracement of the rally from 99.70 on April 14 to 101.14 on April 17 comes in a 100.25.
Technical analysts at a European bank in London said the reverse head and shoulders pattern for Bunds still looked bullish and the contract was well positioned to challenge resistance at 101.12/13.
"Once overcome, the way is clear for a push to 101.60," they said in a research note.
That level is just below the March 17 high from where the market pulled back to 100.15.
At the short end, June Euromarks were at 96.76, up 0.01.
The European bank analysts said there was scope for the contact to push to the low 96.80s, with support coming in above 96.70.
